extName.description: Extension name; must not include Google trademarks

extDescription.message: Preview, zoom, copy and download images in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides, with on-device OCR and one-click ZIP export.

cropHint.message: Drag over the text to recognize; it starts when you release.

toastCropEmpty.message: The selected area doesn't contain any image.

toastClipboardUnsupported.message: This browser can't put images on the clipboard.

toastImageUnreadable.message: Couldn't read this image. Select it again and retry.

toastClipboardBlocked.message: Couldn't write to the clipboard. Click the page and try again.

toastNoImageSource.message: Couldn't find this image's source. Select it again.

toastDownloadFailed.message: Download failed. Select the image again and retry.

toastExporting.message: Getting the document export from Google…

toastExportFallback.message: The document export isn't available; packing loaded images instead…

toastNoImagesFound.message: No images found in this document.

toastZipDonePartial.message: Packed $COUNT$ images; $FAILED$ failed (see the report in the ZIP).

toastZipDonePartialOne.message: Packed $COUNT$ image; $FAILED$ failed (see the report in the ZIP).

toastZipFailed.message: Packing failed: no image could be downloaded.

toastOcrNoImage.message: No image selected for text recognition.

toastOcrCopyFailed.message: Text recognized, but it couldn't be written to the clipboard. Try again.

toastOcrNoText.message: No text detected in the image.

popupExportIdle.message: Save the document's images as a ZIP file.

popupUsageTitle.message: Click an image in the document

popupUsageBody.message: These buttons appear just outside it:

popupUnsupportedHint.message: Open a Google Docs, Sheets or Slides file to download its images. If one is open, reload the page and try again.

popupResultLoaded.message: Packed $COUNT$ loaded images. The document export wasn't available, so pages you haven't scrolled to may be missing.

popupResultLoadedOne.message: Packed $COUNT$ loaded image. The document export wasn't available, so pages you haven't scrolled to may be missing.

popupResultNone.message: No images found in this document.

popupExportFailed.message: The download didn't complete. Reload the document and try again.

popupOpenFailed.message: The panel failed to open. Close it and try again.

htmlLang.description: BCP 47 language tag of this locale, used for the html lang attribute
